fields.name: TvpMapper.ToTvpRecord<TModel> mapping family
fields.contract: TvpMapper converts one mapped TModel instance into a SqlDataRecord suitable for a table-valued parameter. The two overloads differ only by whether the caller supplies a column list: without it, the record contains all mapped columns; with it, the returned metadata fields are selected by exact mapped column name and ordered exactly as requested. Model properties are considered in metadata-token order while the mapping is built.
